questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Starch is the polymer of
questions.solution:
Starch is the main storage polysaccharide of plants. It is a polymer of $\alpha$-D-glucose.
$\underset{\text { Starch }}{\left(\mathrm{C}_6 \mathrm{H}_{10} \mathrm{O}_5\right)_n} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{H}^{+}} \underset{\text { Maltose }}{\mathrm{C}_{12} \mathrm{H}_{22} \mathrm{O}_{11}} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{H}^{+}} \underset{\text { D-glucose }}{\mathrm{C}_6 \mathrm{H}_{12} \mathrm{O}_6}$

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Cane sugar charrs on treating with conc. $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{SO}_4$. It is because
questions.solution:
Cane sugar reacts with conc. $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{SO}_4$ to give charrs. It is because $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{SO}_4$ acts as a dehydrating agent.
$\begin{aligned} & \mathrm{C}_{12} \mathrm{H}_{22} \mathrm{O}_{11}+\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{SO}_4 \text { (conc.) } \longrightarrow 12 \mathrm{C} \\ &+11 \mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}+\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{SO}_4\end{aligned}$

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Consider the following amino acids.
(i) Lysine
(ii) Glutamine
(iii) Arginine
(iv) Leucine
(v) Serine
(vi) Proline
(vii) Valine

questions.solution: Among the given amino acids, only two i.e. lysine and arginine are basic amino acid. While all other are neutral amino acid.

questions.q: Which of the following test is performed by carbohydrates?
questions.solution: Molisch's test is a general test for carbohydrates, while ninhydrin test is given by all proteins. Nitroprusside test is given by proteins which contains -SH group. Due to the presence of -CONH linkage, alkaline solution of proteins give biuret test.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Complete hydrolysis of cellulose gives
questions.solution:
Cellulose is a polysaccharide, composed of D-glucose units which are joined by $\beta$-glycosidic linkages. On complete hydrolysis cellulose produces D-glucose.
$\left(\mathrm{C}_6 \mathrm{H}_{10} \mathrm{O}_5\right)_n+n \mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{H}^{+}} \underset{\text { D-glucose }}{n \mathrm{C}_6 \mathrm{H}_{12} \mathrm{O}_6}$

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The saponification value of an oil or fat is measured in terms of
questions.solution: Saponification value is the number of mg of KOH required to neutralise the fatty acid resulting from the complete hydrolysis of 1 g of oil or fat.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which one of the following is not a protein?
questions.solution: Proteins are the polymer of amino acids and contain polypeptide bonds. DNA, however, are the polymers of nucleotide and contain no polypeptide bond. Hence, DNA is not a protein.
